not_a_claim: n = 4 per cell is exploratory depth resolution; one endpoint, one firing; a trace-recovered verdict is not evidence the model computed anything (claim ladder C4), it is a readout of what the surfaced text says; the char-proportional verdict position is an estimate, not a tokenizer measurement
question: When ladder accuracy fails at high hop depth at matched input load, is the failure in the traversal (capability) or in the delivery of the verdict through the 2048-token cap (surfacing)?

reference_firings.issue126: the archived cap-bound selection premise no longer holds on the current builds: round 49 read 0/11 truncations at 2048

round6.readout: 40/40 correct, 0 truncations at k <= 16; completion_tokens = -36 + 80k; the verdict is emitted after the traversal

rows.D1_anchor_round6_items_ge: the four archived round-6 k=8 items (same seeds, same template) stay at or above 3/4 delivered accuracy on this firing (round 6 read 4/4)
rows.D2_shallow_matched_accuracy_ge: matched-load cells M08+M16 stay at or above 7/8 delivered accuracy
rows.D3_load_at_depth16_ge: tripling the input load at k=16 (192 facts) keeps accuracy at or above 3/4 (round 6's k=16 items averaged 232 facts and read 4/4)
rows.D4_no_ceiling_at_matched_k32_ge: at matched load, k=32 stays at or above 3/4 delivered accuracy: no depth ceiling inside 4x the archived grid at constant prompt size
rows.D5_load_does_not_help_at_depth: matched-minus-high accuracy at k=32 >= 0: load does not improve accuracy at fixed depth
rows.D6_matched_above_baseline_ge: matched-load accuracy at or above 10/16, i.e. strictly above the 0.50 constant baseline the balanced cells put there by construction
rows.N1_census_channel_open: issue #105: the reasoning-supplying field is non-empty on the health call and on >= 90% of dispatched records; otherwise every trace-derived row is refused and the round is an answer-level claim only
rows.N2_duplicate_pairs_byte_identical_ge: issue #100: at least 2 of the 3 duplicate pairs byte-identical (answer field and trace), token-count identity reported alongside
rows.N3_trace_recovery_calibration_ge: the trace-recovery rule (last standalone yes/no of the trace) agrees with the delivered answer field on >= 75% of delivered records; if it does not, T1 and the slope row are refused, not reported
rows.R_depth_turnover_at_matched_load: readout, never a tier by itself: M08 minus M32 accuracy >= 0.25 marks a turnover inside the grid extension
rows.R_verdict_position_slope: readout: OLS slope of the estimated verdict surface position against depth over the matched cells, round 6's law predicts 80 tokens per hop, band [55, 110]
rows.T1_undelivered_trace_correct: the decisive row: among undelivered records with trace text, the trace-recovered verdict equals gold in >= 2/3 => surfacing_bound; below that => capability_bound; admissible only if N1 and N3 hold

tier_rule: T1 capability_bound and a registered turnover => capability_bound_depth
no undelivered record and D4 holds => no_ceiling_measured
